title: Multi-Version Magic Header Parsing & Section Map Validation for Unity IL2CPP

claims.evidence_quote: export const IL2CPP_METADATA_MAGIC = 0xfab11baf; ... Header section order shared by global-metadata.dat versions 29, 31 and 39.
